title: Triage the Shared Inbox
summary: Sort incoming messages by type and urgency, and draft replies for you to approve before anything is sent.

money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Routine replies take less time to write.
who_its_for: Small teams with one shared support or sales inbox.
